comment: Frame, edit-path, CSV large-table (CS-30) and 16 MiB code-adapter (CE-30) budgets enforced by tools/bench-editor.py --check. Milliseconds of CPU per frame (input dispatch through Window::draw: build, layout, prepaint, paint), release build, Apple Silicon (local calibration: Apple M2 Pro, max of 3 consecutive runs * 1.5). Means, not p95: the tail follows machine load. A 120Hz display leaves 8.3ms a frame for everything, the GPU included.

ci.comment: Shared GitHub macos-15 runners are virtualized and slower/noisier than local Apple M2 Pro hardware. Scaling checks (maxRatio) are hardware-independent and always enforced strictly (zero pending waivers remain). Absolute maxMs ceilings use per-budget `ciMaxMs` calibrated from max(mean over 3 consecutive macos-15 runs) * 1.5 once runner calibration completes; while `calibrated` is false during initial runner calibration, `uncalibratedMultiplier` (x2.0) prevents shared-VM false failures while result.json is collected.

scaling.comment: A frame costs what is on screen: a document 10x-100x longer may not cost twice as much.
